facts.fact: 出庭准备：Mildred 第一次不知道该给她穿什么——她选最隆重的 parade uniform+phalerae 勋章带+Skrendith 之战的 torque（Shadow Vision 夜导 century 包抄的勋章）
facts.anchor: If they want to judge me for my actions in the trials

facts.fact: 护送之争：Lucan 剥 Draven 的代理权（Lord Theron 回来了）——Draven「I'll not have her escorted without allies」+「You just won't have my Marked alone, Lucan」——Lucan 挨了耳光似的表情（活该：瞒了她那么久）
facts.anchor: “You are no longer proxy now that Lord Theron has returned,”

facts.fact: 她的反击：「Am I not still a member of the King's Royal Guard and a decorated commander in Arkendrath?」——勋章替她回答；「High General Nash has ordered them to watch over me, so they shall escort me」
facts.anchor: Am I not still a member of the King’s Royal Guard

facts.fact: 庭上自辩：「我只为救 Commander Nash 与 Evelyn 而行动」+「我从未被告知自己的血统——一个 Reynolds 从我受孕起就怀疑的血统」——全场倒吸气；Mona 攻击「How dare you speak of the king you killed?」——她回敬「I saved your daughter…You should be thankful I had a hidden ability」；「Just tell the people I'm sorry for the devastation」
facts.anchor: a lineage King Reynolds suspected as a possibility since my conception.”

facts.fact: 回程清算：Lucan 的「I did it because I wanted you.」+抓臂——她一拳（他受着不躲）+「I love you, Lavina…I was only waiting out the sentence of losing you」——「I was never yours! You lost me as a friend—that is all」；「I'm not doing it for you. I'm putting the realm first—as I always do.」
facts.anchor: “I was never yours! You lost me as a friend—that is all, Lucan,”
